answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its sable recurs, its vine survives audit, and a pearl from an unlinked peer confirms it.
